codes.BUDGET.EXHAUSTED: No allocation available for the action.
codes.CONTRACT.DIGEST_MISMATCH: Retained bytes do not match the immutable reference.
codes.CONTRACT.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: An existing logical key has a different semantic payload.
codes.CONTRACT.INPUT_NOT_PINNED: Consumer read outside its declared input closure.
codes.CONTRACT.INVALID_PAYLOAD: Declared domain payload schema failed validation.
codes.EFFECT.ACCEPTANCE_UNKNOWN: External acceptance must be reconciled before any retry.
codes.EVIDENCE.CONFLICT: Complete claim group has unresolved contradictory support.
codes.EVIDENCE.DENOMINATOR_UNAVAILABLE: A statistic depends on unavailable sample membership/evidence.
codes.EVIDENCE.PRODUCER_FAILED: Positive output depends on an unsuccessful producer.
codes.EVIDENCE.STALE: Required support expired for this evaluation/use.
codes.MODEL.INVALID_OUTPUT: Bounded parsing/repair did not produce a valid typed output.
codes.MODULE.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: Operation exceeded its allowed deadline; terminal diagnostics may finalize later without authorizing late outputs or effects.
codes.MODULE.IMPLEMENTATION_MISSING: Enabled operation has no registered implementation.
codes.MODULE.NOT_APPLICABLE: Operation not selected for this target/profile.
codes.NETWORK.RATE_LIMITED: Source rate limit requires policy-controlled stop/backoff.
codes.POLICY.REVOKED: Current rights or authority were revoked.
codes.POLICY.SOURCE_DENIED: Acquisition/use not allowed by the source policy.
codes.POLICY.TENANT_DENIED: Authenticated tenant does not own or have access to the referenced data.
codes.REVIEW.REVISION_CHANGED: Review no longer matches exact package revision/content.
codes.STORAGE.COMMIT_FAILED: Internal records could not be committed consistently.

scope: Proposed diagnostic code registry; code does not authorize suggested remediation.
